method: Weighted engineering estimate with explicit operational phase exits, not a percentage of lines written

items.earned_basis: 5/6: audited rolling collector, local collection archive, PostgreSQL base contract, individual-journal importer, and now atomic collection import with permanent parent revocation executed on PostgreSQL 18.6 in native Termux. Collection evidence verifies 33 SQL checks, actual permissions, concurrent writers, second-window rollback, interrupted-client rollback/retry, all original rows, receipts, eligibility views and orderly restart. The remaining point requires operational collector/database connection, remote storage/broker/workflow integration, prolonged operation, observability and joint recovery. No operational phase exit is closed.
